title: Small Magnet Top for SLX Tray
description:
SLX Small Magnet Top
The Small Magnet Top lid is specifically designed for use with the SLX Small Non-Stick Ceramic Coated Tray. The entire lid is made out of a sheet of magnet and has a beautiful piece of art called Love Birds.
Included
1 x SLX Small Magnet Top
